'''Eddy Lee''' is a voice actor for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Lee was born sometime on March 21 and became a voice actor as an adult. He mostly worked on the English-dubbed versions of Japanese anime series. He joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|SM}}, where he voiced {{an|Lillie}}'s older brother {{an|Gladion}}.
